items.key: lesson|_tz3210_5rta89nj|TS0601|window pusher routed as wall dimmer
items.symptom: MOES ZC-LP01 sliding window pusher would pair as a wall dimmer
items.cause: stale local mfs hint (confidence 0.08, TS0601_dim1) listed the manufacturer on wall_dimmer_tuya, whose productId includes TS0601
items.check: compose: couple is on curtain_motor, absent from wall_dimmer_tuya; dpMappings lock DP102=state DP104=position DP4=battery
items.fix: move exact couple to curtain_motor, sacred DP map from Z2M/ZHC, onMapDeviceClass so already-paired devices keep the same id
items.evidence: Z2M ZC-LP01; ZHC moes.ts; forum 156967 post 101

items.key: lesson|cover|DP2 vs DP3|target position overwrites actual
items.symptom: curtain tile stuck on last requested position; hand moves not shown
items.cause: DP2 is target/set; actual position is often DP3 (or another report DP). Updating the tile from the target DP after the actual DP has reported hides the real position.
items.check: CoverPositionSource.accept(2, x) is false after accept(3, y)
items.fix: wire CoverPositionSource into UnifiedCoverBase as well as wifi_cover

items.symptom: device request; ZHA exposes unused temp/humidity/lux and PIR stays off without a Tuya handshake
items.cause: fingerprint missing from our motion drivers; advertised clusters are not proof of hardware
items.check: pir_sensor_2 lists the exact couple; capabilities stay alarm_motion + battery (no invented temp/humidity)
items.fix: add exact couple to pir_sensor_2 (IAS Zone already handled)
items.evidence: forum 162420 post 1; ZHA issue 5709; Z2M TS020C page as family reference

items.symptom: after re-pair or driver move, Flows still point at the old device id
items.cause: Homey binds flow cards to a device UUID; a new pairing gets a new id
items.check: prefer onMapDeviceClass so the id is kept; if re-pair is required, changelog/digest/settings mention Flow Converter
items.fix: in-place map first; settings preview + optional Flow Converter; do not request homey:manager:api on this device app
items.evidence: forum 154906 (late4marshmellow Flow Converter, capability mapping since 1.2.0)

items.symptom: Tuya Cloud tile showed 163 C for a 16.3 C electric radiator
items.cause: Tuya often ships temperatures with a decimal scale; treating the raw integer as Celsius overshoots by 10
items.check: TemperatureDivisorGuard scales 163 to 16.3 and leaves 16.3 untouched; learned after 3 samples; never re-applied to in-range values
items.fix: Bounded per-device auto-detection (divisors 1/10/100) wired into TuyaLocalDevice._fromDeviceValue

items.symptom: Scene remotes fire two single-press events about 1s apart after a restart
items.cause: Two real frames; short transport dedup does not cover a 1s gap
items.check: PostRestartPressDedup drops a second single within 1.5s only in the 120s post-start window; never drops typed double
items.fix: Generic helper compatible with PressActionDedup, wired in ButtonDevice.triggerButtonPress

items.key: lesson|_tz3000_wkai4ga5|ts0044|duplicate trigger per press; missing long press|two cluster-6 frames per press (commandon/off/toggle + tuya 0xfd); transport-keyed dedup and double listener registration after re-init/migration
items.symptom: duplicate trigger per press; missing long press
items.cause: two cluster-6 frames per press (commandOn/Off/Toggle + Tuya 0xFD); transport-keyed dedup and double listener registration after re-init/migration
items.check: assert PressActionDedup drops mixed transports for the same endpoint+action; installOnce on zclNode
items.fix: dedup per endpoint+action in a short window; bind listeners once per zclNode; forward release only when sent (MOES long press about 5s)
items.evidence: JohanBendz/com.tuya.zigbee issues #864 and #793, commits around 2024-10-12 (v0.2.71-v0.2.73). Reporters RBouroubi, roxart, SunBeech. Forum 26439/5542 read-only lesson (v0.3.4 regression after revamp, gone after Homey restart post-migration).

items.key: lesson|_tz3000_qja6nq5z|ts004f|extra presses, light fades, ring/dial|ts004f moes knob: one press arrives as on/off/toggle plus another path; rotation is a separate action; re-init can double-bind listeners
items.cause: TS004F Moes knob: one press arrives as on/off/toggle plus another path; rotation is a separate action; re-init can double-bind listeners
items.check: assert dimmer mode on smart_knob_rotary only; on/off/toggle collapse; rotate_left is not dropped; installOnce
items.fix: PressActionDedup with on/off/toggle mapped to single; installOnce per zclNode; keep dimmer/levelControl for the ring
items.evidence: Johan topic 26439 post 5537 (read-only). DeviceOperatingMode KNOB_MFR already lists qja6nq5z.

items.key: lesson|_tz3000_ja5osu5g|ts004f|button stopped working|1-button ts004f scene remote (sibling of kaflzta4) needs 0x8004=event; a stuck dimmer setting or a 4-button/knob_rotary placement silences 0xfd
items.cause: 1-button TS004F scene remote (sibling of kaflzta4) needs 0x8004=event; a stuck dimmer setting or a 4-button/knob_rotary placement silences 0xFD
items.check: assert owners are only smart_knob; applyDesiredMode resets stuck dimmer to scene
items.fix: Keep on smart_knob, force scene mode, never write command/dimmer unless the user opts in
items.evidence: Johan topic 26439 post 5541 (read-only, IEEE anonymized). P2453/P2450 already locked the couple.

items.key: lesson|_tze200_bjawzodf|ts0601|humidity x10; ty0201 pairing as a switch|ef00 lcd humidity is often raw x10; _tz3000_bjawzodf+ty0201 is a different zcl couple that must stay on lcdtemphumidsensor (not a switch)
items.symptom: humidity x10; TY0201 pairing as a switch
items.cause: EF00 LCD humidity is often raw x10; _TZ3000_bjawzodf+TY0201 is a different ZCL couple that must stay on lcdtemphumidsensor (not a switch)
items.check: scaleHumidity(450)=45, 80=80; exact owners climate_sensor vs lcdtemphumidsensor, class sensor
items.fix: Adaptive humidity scale (values >100 /10) on climate_sensor for bjawzodf; keep the TZ3000 TY0201/TS0201 couple on lcdtemphumidsensor
items.evidence: Johan topic 26439 post 5540 (read-only). Z2M TS0601_temperature_humidity_sensor_1. P2266/P3295/P3141.

items.key: lesson|hobeian|zg-204zm|radar present but no control|dp107/dp122 must be bool/enum (value writes are ignored); _tze200_kb5noeto is ias on pir_sensor_2, not this radar map
items.cause: DP107/DP122 must be bool/enum (VALUE writes are ignored); _TZE200_kb5noeto is IAS on pir_sensor_2, not this radar map
items.check: getSensorConfig HOBEIAN/ZG-204ZM matches Z2M DP1/2/4/107/122; kb5noeto not in the ZG-204ZM radar block
items.fix: Keep HOBEIAN + _TZE200_2aaelwxk on presence_sensor_radar with the Z2M dpMap; leave kb5noeto on pir_sensor_2
items.evidence: Johan topic 26439 post 5538 (read-only). Z2M hobeian.ts / tuya.ts. P3141/P3155/P2421.

items.key: lesson|21313|onoff listener and late setpoint caps
items.symptom: Missing Capability Listener: onoff; Wi-Fi thermostat exposed ambient only
items.cause: onoff capability present without a listener; setpoint DPs never added the target cap
items.check: ensureOnoffListener registers once; ensureSetpointCapability adds target_temperature on DPs 2/16/111 only, never removes ambient
